issues.description: The Person update endpoint in the solution uses a String-typed @PathVariable for personId while the Note update endpoint uses a UUID-typed @PathVariable. The problem statement describes updating a person based on a UUID. This mismatch (String vs UUID) between similar endpoints is inconsistent and can confuse students implementing the PersonResource (they will likely follow the NoteResource pattern and expect a UUID parameter).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person update endpoint consistent with the Note update endpoint and the problem description by using a UUID-typed @PathVariable (e.g. @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId) and compare updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId). This aligns the parameter types across endpoints and matches the UUID-based requirement in the spec.
